full_details.title: UGC Testimonial Creators Needed – AI Wealth Accelerator Kit & AI Architecture Program
full_details.full_description:
We are looking for 10 professional UGC creators to create authentic testimonial-style videos for our AI education and business products.

We are hiring:

5 creators for the AI Wealth Accelerator Kit
5 creators for the AI Architecture Program

The ideal candidates are entrepreneurs, business professionals, technology professionals, founders, consultants, AI enthusiasts or experienced UGC creators who are confident speaking on camera.

The videos will be used for social media, landing pages and digital marketing campaigns.

PROJECT A — 5 Creators for AI Wealth Accelerator Kit
Target Audience

Entrepreneurs, founders, business owners, consultants and professionals interested in using AI to identify business opportunities, improve productivity and build AI-powered businesses.

Testimonial Talking Points

Creators can use the following points as guidance:

Briefly introduce yourself and your professional background.
Explain why you are interested in AI and entrepreneurship.
Share your first impression of the AI Wealth Accelerator Kit.
Mention 2–3 specific benefits, frameworks, tools or ideas you found valuable.
Discuss how the kit can help entrepreneurs identify AI-powered opportunities.
Mention how AI can support productivity, automation and business growth.
Share your favorite takeaway.
Explain who you think would benefit from the kit.
Give your genuine overall opinion.
End with a natural recommendation based on your actual experience.
Video Requirements
Professional blazer/business attire required
Professional entrepreneur/business-professional appearance
45–90 seconds
Vertical 9:16
Clear audio
Good lighting
Clean, professional background
Natural and confident delivery
Avoid sounding like you are reading a script
No exaggerated income or financial claims
PROJECT B — 5 Creators for AI Architecture Program
Target Audience

Technology professionals, software engineers, cloud professionals, architects, engineering managers, consultants, founders and business/technology leaders who want to develop advanced AI Architecture capabilities.

Testimonial Talking Points

Creators can use these points as guidance:

Briefly introduce yourself and your technology/professional background.
Explain why AI Architecture is becoming important.
Share your first impression of the AI Architecture Program.
Mention 2–3 modules or concepts that stood out to you.
Discuss topics such as Enterprise AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Prompt & Context Engineering, AI Strategy or AI Governance, where applicable.
Explain how an architecture-focused approach differs from simply learning AI tools.
Share your favorite learning takeaway.
Explain how the program could be relevant to technology professionals or business leaders.
Give your genuine overall assessment.
End with a natural recommendation based on your actual experience.
Video Requirements
Professional blazer/business attire required
Executive/professional appearance
60–90 seconds
Vertical 9:16
Good lighting and clear audio
Professional office/home-office background preferred
Confident, knowledgeable and conversational delivery
No exaggerated career, salary or employment claims
IMPORTANT — AUTHENTICITY

These are intended to be genuine testimonial/review videos.

Creators must not falsely claim that they:

Purchased the product if they did not
Completed the program if they did not
Became a student/graduate if they did not
Generated specific income or business results they did not actually achieve
Obtained a job, promotion or client because of the program unless this genuinely occurred

Creators will be provided with the appropriate product/program information or materials before recording so that their comments are based on what they have actually reviewed or experienced.

The video should feel like a real professional recommendation, not a fabricated customer story.

Ideal Creator Profile

We especially welcome:

Entrepreneurs
Founders
Business owners
AI professionals
Software engineers
Cloud architects
Technology managers
Consultants
Product managers
Technology leaders
Experienced UGC creators
Application Requirements

Please include:

Your professional background
Which project you are applying for:
AI Wealth Accelerator Kit
AI Architecture Program
Your experience with UGC/testimonial videos
1–2 examples of previous videos, if available
Confirmation that you can record wearing a professional blazer/business attire
Your turnaround time
Your price for one completed video
Your availability for one reasonable revision
Deliverable

Each selected creator will provide:

1 original 45–90 second vertical UGC video
High-quality video file
Clear audio
No watermark
One reasonable revision
Agreed usage rights for social media, website and digital advertising

We will select 10 creators in total — 5 for each campaign.
